$comment: Shard definitions for the Stryker matrix in .github/workflows/test-quality.yml. Read by that workflow (`node -p`), never by Stryker itself, so it stays out of stryker.config.json (which warns on unknown keys). Single files can be split by line range (`path:start-end`), which is the only way to divide a file whose tests are slow (e.g. the wasm runners). Shards are kept under ~10 minutes by measurement, not by mutant count alone. Regenerate if src/lib changes materially.
